title: Securing database operations
subtitle: Constrain credentials, queries, disclosure, and recovery—not only SQL strings.
goal: Protect data even when a query or role is misused
intro: Database security combines privileges, query boundaries, connection identity, and data lifecycle controls.
case: A forgotten owner filter must not expose every customer's records.
Role separation and tested row policies reduce the consequences of mistakes.
A privileged database role may bypass the policy you thought protected rows.
